from fastapi import FastAPI, Body
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from pydantic import BaseModel

app = FastAPI()

class Item(BaseModel):
    name: str

@app.post("/items")
async def create_item(item: Item = Body(...)):
    return item

@app.post("/items-strict")
async def create_item_strict(item: Item = Body(..., strict_content_type=True)):
    return item

client = TestClient(app)

def test_no_content_type():
    # Currently, FastAPI assumes JSON if Content-Type is missing
    response = client.post("/items", content='{"name": "test"}')
    print(f"No Content-Type (lenient): {response.status_code}, {response.json()}")

def test_no_content_type_strict():
    # With strict_content_type=True, FastAPI should NOT assume JSON if Content-Type is missing
    response = client.post("/items-strict", content='{"name": "test"}')
    print(f"No Content-Type (strict): {response.status_code}, {response.json()}")

def test_wrong_content_type():
    # Currently, FastAPI does NOT assume JSON if Content-Type is wrong
    response = client.post("/items", content='{"name": "test"}', headers={"Content-Type": "text/plain"})
    print(f"Wrong Content-Type (lenient): {response.status_code}, {response.json()}")

def test_wrong_content_type_strict():
    # With strict_content_type=True, FastAPI should still NOT assume JSON if Content-Type is wrong
    response = client.post("/items-strict", content='{"name": "test"}', headers={"Content-Type": "text/plain"})
    print(f"Wrong Content-Type (strict): {response.status_code}, {response.json()}")

def test_correct_content_type_strict():
    # With strict_content_type=True, it should still work if Content-Type is correct
    response = client.post("/items-strict", content='{"name": "test"}', headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
    print(f"Correct Content-Type (strict): {response.status_code}, {response.json()}")

if __name__ == "__main__":

    test_no_content_type_strict()
    test_wrong_content_type()
    test_wrong_content_type_strict()
    test_correct_content_type_strict()
